# Butterfly Fashion Trading

> Canadian B2B wholesale supplier based in Toronto (North York, Ontario). We supply
> variety, novelty, and seasonal goods in bulk to retailers across Canada
> and the United States. In business since 1996.

## What we sell (wholesale, by the case)
- Winter accessories: gloves, toques/hats, balaclavas, masks
- Fidget & novelty toys: squishies, fidgets, trending impulse items

## Who we serve
Dollar & variety stores, toy & gift shops, convenience stores, arcades, and event
resellers across Canada and the USA.

## Wholesale terms
- Minimum order: none — order any quantity. Some custom or special-order items require one case per item (most items 12–50 units/case)
- Pricing: wholesale pricing visible after free B2B account approval (usually within 24 hours)
- Fulfillment: pickup or shipping from our Toronto warehouse; ships across Canada & the USA
- Payment: Stripe payment link, e-transfer, cash (pickup), or bank transfer
- Invoicing with NET 30 available for established accounts

## Location & contact
- Address: 178 Bentworth Ave, North York, ON M6A 1P7, Canada
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 9 AM – 5 PM ET
- Email: orders@butterfly-fashion.ca
- Phone: +1-416-785-5999
